reports.title: Liquidia Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

lines: Under the settlement agreement, Liquidia agreed to pay net $380.7 million in multiple installments in 2026 and 2027, inclusive of payments to other parties to resolve the antitrust litigation against United Therapeutics related to Treprostinil Injection, which the company expects to fund from current cash and cash equivalents and ongoing sales of YUTREPIA.
